maddeler.e:
ننحسر (form VII)
# نَنْحَسِرُ (nanḥasiru) /nan.ħa.si.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# نَنْحَسِرَ (nanḥasira) /nan.ħa.si.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# نَنْحَسِرْ (nanḥasir) /nan.ħa.sir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
